title: Yet Another Plugin Manager
installedHint: Choose a category. Expand or collapse Enabled and Disabled below.
marketHint: Browse third-party plugins from plugins.omarchy.org. Choose whether new installs are enabled below.
updateHint: Checks installed Git repositories directly. No marketplace catalog download is needed.
search: Search by name, ID, or description…
readError: Could not read the plugin manager response.
confirm.install: Install %1? Plugins run with your user’s access. Review the source first; this installs it disabled.
confirm.update: Update %1 from its repository? Review the source first. Local edits are protected.
confirm.remove: Remove %1? Omarchy deletes Git checkouts, including local files. Other local plugins are backed up by Omarchy.
confirm.enable: Enable %1 as your shell bar? This replaces the currently selected bar.
fetchFirst: Choose Refresh catalog to browse the marketplace.
checkFirst: Choose Check updates to check your installed Git plugins.
offlineHint: Installed controls work offline. Network checks are manual.
done.install: Plugin installed. Find it in Installed to enable it.
enableAfterInstallOn: New plugins will be enabled immediately after installation.
enableAfterInstallOff: New plugins will stay disabled until you enable them.
confirm.install-enable: Install and enable %1? The plugin will run immediately with your user’s access. Review the source first.
noDescription: No description provided by this plugin.
updateDisclaimer: Updates fetch the latest default-branch commit from Git, which may be newer than published releases. Review changes first. Use plugins and apply updates at your own discretion.
marketplaceDisclaimer: Plugins download from Git repositories and run with your user’s access. Review the source before installing or enabling them. Use and install plugins at your own discretion.
